implied_move_method: Derived, not quoted. ESTC has no weekly options; nearest expiry after the event is 2026-09-18 (22 days). Two-expiry variance decomposition using Sep-18 ATM IV 85.8% and Oct-16 ATM IV 70.2% gives an event 1SD jump of 16.2%; straddle-equivalent expected absolute move = 0.798 x 16.2% = 12.9%. Cross-check stripping 22 days of the implied 54.9% diffusive vol out of the $13.70 ATM straddle gives 13.5%. CBOE snapshot 2026-08-26T15:59:59 ET.
historical_moves_note: Close-to-close move on the session after each AMC report, oldest first. Computed from Yahoo daily closes; last four corroborated by TipRanks. Up/down pattern: D,U,U,D,D,D,D,U = 3 up / 5 down.
key_metric: Elastic Cloud revenue and its sequential trajectory after the first-ever q/q decline in Q4 FY26 ($217.4M vs $218.0M); consensus $229.23M (+17.1% y/y, +5.4% q/q), Rosenblatt models +19% (~$233M). Secondary: whether FY27 revenue guidance of $1.985-2.000B is raised rather than reiterated, and whether the ~19.0% FY27 non-GAAP operating margin guide is lifted on the un-guided 7% June restructuring.
